outcome: Hospitalization or emergency department (ED) visits for a mental health condition
cohort: Postpartum individuals aged 18 to 55 years with a first hospital delivery between 2008 and 2021 in 11 provinces and territories in Canada, except Québec (n=1,579,392)
finding: Postpartum individuals who experienced SMM during their first delivery had a 26% increased risk of mental health hospitalization or ED visits within 13 years compared to those without SMM.
mod_finding: The study found that individuals with severe maternal morbidity (SMM) had an increased risk of mental health hospitalizations or ED visits, and those with SMM were more likely to have had a cesarean delivery.
